original_abstract.text: Industrial recommendation faces a resolution--complexity dilemma: dense interactions make detailed modeling of long behavior histories expensive, while compact history summaries restrict the evidence available to prediction. A unified backbone must preserve rich behavioral details within strict serving budgets. We introduce \textbf{TokenFormer V2}, a unified architecture that explicitly decouples \emph{representation resolution} from \emph{interaction density}. Its group-wise token layout jointly encodes behavior segments with non-sequential context, expands interaction ranges via hierarchical group merging, and coordinates distributed groups through \emph{NS Fusion} and \emph{Global Sync} modules. Through this \emph{local--global decomposition} paradigm, computation is concentrated on structured interactions while preserving fine-grained evidence, ensuring that every encoded event remains directly accessible to the \emph{Full-Resolution Readout} module. On the Tencent Advertising Algorithm Competition 2026 (TAAC 2026) benchmark, TokenFormer V2 achieves top-ranking accuracy among unified recommendation baselines while using \textbf{5.1$\times$ fewer FLOPs} than leading baselines, sustaining its advantage across long histories and imbalanced behavior domains. Furthermore, in billion-parameter evaluations on WeChat Channels advertising, it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art industrial baselines, yielding up to a \textbf{+0.07 pp} overall AUC gain. In live online A/B testing against the production model, TokenFormer V2 delivers a statistically significant \textbf{2.33\% increase in GMV}. These results establish TokenFormer V2 as a battle-tested blueprint for scalable, full-resolution behavior modeling in industrial recommendation.
original_abstract.source_title: TokenFormer V2: Breaking the Resolution-Complexity Dilemma in Unified Recommendation

en.text: TokenFormer V2 preserves individual behavior representations while limiting interaction density through local groups, hierarchical merging, non-sequential feature fusion and global synchronization. A full-resolution readout retains access to every encoded event. On TAAC 2026 it reports top-ranking accuracy among unified baselines with 5.1 times fewer FLOPs than leading baselines; billion-parameter WeChat Channels evaluations show up to 0.07 percentage-point overall AUC improvement. Online testing against the production model reports 2.33% GMV lift. This directly addresses the compute cost of unified feature and long-sequence ranking without compressing away event-level access.

zh.text: TokenFormer V2 保留每个行为的独立表示，通过局部分组、层级合并、非序列特征融合和全局同步控制交互密度，预测时仍能直接读取每个编码后的事件。在 TAAC 2026 上，它以领先基线约 1/5.1 的 FLOPs达到统一推荐基线中的领先精度；微信视频号十亿参数评估中，整体 AUC 最多提高 0.07 个百分点，线上对比生产模型的 GMV 提高 2.33%。它提供了一种保留行为细节、同时控制特征与长序列统一建模成本的设计。

original_abstract.text:
Sequential recommendation has recently witnessed growing interest in generative retrieval. One of the most popular approaches is to autoregressively generate the semantic identifiers (SIDs) of items as recommendations. Existing efforts mainly rely on semantic alignment, sophisticated architectural designs, and extensive hyperparameter tuning. However, the conventional learning framework for generative models could have foundational limitations. Specifically, most generative models directly predict target items without explicitly learning negative compositions and relative ranking signals. This is not well aligned with the philosophy of Bayesian personalized ranking (BPR), which emphasizes the importance of relative rankings between positive and negative samples.
  In this paper, we show that adding a simple multiple-choice auxiliary task into the learning objective can effectively address this issue. With minimal adaptation, we introduce Task Identifiers and Candidate Constructions to synthesize training data for the multiple-choice auxiliary task. In addition, we provide theoretical analysis of the fundamental benefits of the multiple-choice auxiliary task from the perspectives of information theory and compositional generalization. Extensive experiments on four publicly available benchmark datasets show that our approach can improve TIGER, a conventional generative recommendation model, by 4.9% to 79% in NDCG@10.
original_abstract.source_title: Keep it Simple! A Multiple-Choice Task can Benefit Generative Recommendation

en.text: This work adds a multiple-choice auxiliary task to semantic-ID generative recommendation so training explicitly learns relative rankings between positive and negative candidates. Task identifiers and candidate construction provide the additional supervision with little architectural adaptation. On four public benchmarks, the method improves TIGER’s NDCG@10 by 4.9–79%. It offers an objective-level route to improving generative retrieval, with gains limited to the evaluated model and datasets rather than industrial CTR evidence.

zh.text: 该工作给语义 ID 生成式推荐加入多选辅助任务，让模型显式学习正负候选的相对顺序。任务标识和候选构造提供额外监督，只需少量适配。四个公开基准中，TIGER 的 NDCG@10 提高 4.9%–79%。可借鉴之处是从训练目标改善生成式召回，而非一味扩大模型；收益范围是所测模型和数据集，不是工业 CTR 结果。

original_abstract.text: Conventional linear routers in sparse mixture-of-experts models select experts directly from token-expert matching scores, coupling input matching with expert allocation. We propose Prototype-Mediated Routing (PMR), a two-stage router with shared prototypes. PMR first computes each token's distribution over prototypes, then uses it to mix prototype-conditioned expert distributions according to the law of total probability. This formulation models input matching and expert allocation separately, explicitly represents many-to-many associations between prototypes and experts, and provides separate interfaces for context adaptation and load regulation. Within this framework, short-term states summarize preceding tokens to adapt the prototypes, while congestion prices updated from dispatch feedback achieve loss-free load balancing by adjusting the conditional expert distributions. We use a two-pass blockwise approximation to accelerate short-term state processing, achieving over 20 times the training throughput of the eager tokenwise PMR implementation while maintaining high agreement in routing decisions. Across three pretraining configurations with 0.43B, 1.18B, and 0.48B total parameters, PMR improves mean zero-shot accuracy on seven benchmarks over linear routing baselines with matched expert architectures by 1.54, 2.65, and 1.45 percentage points (pp), respectively. The corresponding gains on ARC-Easy are 6.71, 5.80, and 3.92 pp. In parameter-efficient fine-tuning of 7B-8B backbones, PMR's improvements over MixLoRA vary across backbones, with gains of up to 1.76 pp in mean accuracy across four tasks.
original_abstract.source_title: PMR: MoE Routing with Shared Prototypes and Congestion Pricing

en.text: PMR routes tokens through shared prototypes before mixing prototype-conditioned expert distributions, separating input matching from expert allocation. Short-term context adapts prototypes, and dispatch-feedback congestion prices regulate load without an auxiliary balancing loss. Three pretraining configurations improve mean zero-shot accuracy over matched-expert linear routers. Two-pass processing is over 20× faster than eager tokenwise PMR, not a claim of 20× acceleration over standard MoE. The mechanism may inform adaptive, balanced sparse recommendation architectures.

zh.text: PMR 先计算词元对共享原型的分布，再混合各原型对应的专家分布，将输入匹配与专家分配拆开。短期上下文调整原型，派发反馈形成的拥塞价格调节负载，无需额外均衡损失。三个预训练配置的平均零样本准确率优于专家架构匹配的线性路由。两遍分块实现比逐词元 PMR 快超过 20 倍，这不等于比标准 MoE 快 20 倍。可借鉴其自适应路由与负载调节机制。

original_abstract.text:
Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality.
  We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. We identify three issues: (i) clipped surrogates create dead-gradient regions, under-utilizing samples; (ii) negative-advantage updates can become effectively unbounded as importance ratios grow, allowing a small subset of negatives to dominate optimization; and (iii) ratio-based control lacks sensitivity to absolute policy confidence, so updates on high-confidence cases may fail to vanish.
  Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \emph{Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization} (GBPO), a simple objective with stop-gradient normalization that is simultaneously (a) fully gradient-active, (b) sign-symmetrically bounded for both positive and negative updates, and (c) explicitly confidence-weighted under current policy probabilities. This ensures that updates gracefully vanish for $π\!\to\!1$ positives and $π\!\to\!0$ negatives. Across the evaluated settings, GBPO achieves competitive recommendation performance with more stable training than competing RL methods.
original_abstract.source_title: Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models

en.text: GBPO diagnoses dead-gradient regions, oversized negative updates and weak confidence sensitivity in ratio-based RL objectives for generative recommendation. Stop-gradient normalization keeps both positive and negative logit updates bounded and makes updates vanish as the policy becomes confident in the appropriate direction. The evaluated settings show competitive recommendation quality with more stable training. Its relevance to scaling is a training-stability mechanism for recommendation post-training, not a demonstrated scaling law.

zh.text: GBPO 分析生成式推荐中基于概率比值的强化学习目标，指出梯度被截断、负向更新过大和对当前置信度不够敏感的问题。方法用停止梯度的归一化同时约束正负更新，并让模型在正确方向已足够自信时逐渐减小更新。所测设置中推荐效果具有竞争力、训练更稳定。对 scaling 的借鉴集中在后训练稳定性，论文没有建立规模定律。

original_abstract.text: Despite growing interest in on-device LLM deployment, large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models remain impractical on resource-constrained devices, as sparse expert activation still requires all expert weights to be memory-resident. To address this, we identify three key observations for on-device MoE inference: (a) cache hit rates are fundamentally bounded even under Belady's optimal policy; (b) these bounds are insufficient for low-latency on-device inference; and (c) prior cache-aware routing based on binary cache presence can induce routing instability. Based on these insights, we propose CECAR (Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing), a MoE inference system that jointly considers expert routing and cache management. Unlike prior cache-aware routing methods, CECAR uses an ML-based cache policy to predict the expected reuse distance of each expert and prioritizes routing and execution toward experts with smaller predicted reuse distances. On the Qwen3-30B-A3B model, CECAR achieves 12.5 tokens/s on a consumer-grade GPU with only 16 GB of VRAM, where non-resident experts are fetched from SSD, delivering a 4.5x speedup over conventional MoE inference and exceeding the decode speed of baselines that keep the entire model fully resident in DRAM. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/CECAR.
original_abstract.source_title: CECAR: Cache & Expert Co-Aware Routing Accelerates On-Device Inference of MoE LLMs

en.text: CECAR jointly controls expert routing and cache management using predicted expert reuse distances, rather than binary cache presence. This reduces expert-loading pressure when MoE weights exceed GPU memory. On Qwen3-30B-A3B with 16 GB VRAM and SSD-backed nonresident experts, it reports 12.5 tokens/s and 4.5× speedup over conventional MoE inference. Cache-aware sparse routing is a potential design for resource-limited recommendation serving; the measured gains are for the stated language-model setup.

zh.text: CECAR 用预测的专家再次使用距离共同指导路由与缓存管理，减少 MoE 权重超出显存时的专家加载压力。在 16 GB 显存、未驻留专家存于 SSD 的 Qwen3-30B-A3B 配置下，论文报告 12.5 tokens/s，相对传统 MoE 推理快 4.5 倍。面向缓存的稀疏路由可供受资源限制的推荐服务参考，测得收益仅属于上述语言模型配置。

original_abstract.text: Multiplicative gating improves Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs), but it reduces intermediate representation width under a fixed parameter budget. This trade-off is particularly relevant to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, where individual experts have limited capacity. We introduce ParGLU, a partially gated FFN that combines SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ in two parallel branches. ParGLU matches the parameter count and principal matrix computation budget of conventional SwiGLU. We evaluate ParGLU in 30M, 75M, and 152M MoE language models using three random seeds per scale. ParGLU outperforms SwiGLU across all three seeds at 75M and 152M, reducing mean validation NLL by 0.0200 and 0.0249, respectively. Results at 30M are mixed. Controlled ablations show that increasing backbone width or expert width strengthens ParGLU's relative performance. Ablation studies further show that combining SwiGLU and ReLU$^2$ improves performance over either architecture alone. Token-frequency analysis reveals larger improvements on low-frequency tokens. These findings show that fully gated FFNs are not always the most effective use of an MoE expert's parameter budget. Partial gating can improve language modeling in MoE Transformers.
original_abstract.source_title: ParGLU: Partial Gating Improves Language Modeling in MoE Transformers

en.text: ParGLU combines SwiGLU and squared-ReLU branches to trade partial gating for wider expert representations at matched parameter count and principal matrix-computation budget. In three-seed MoE language-model experiments, it improves validation loss consistently at 75M and 152M parameters, while 30M results are mixed. The design suggests reconsidering how sparse recommendation experts spend limited parameters; evidence is small-scale language modeling, not large-model or CTR validation.

zh.text: ParGLU 把 SwiGLU 与平方 ReLU 分支组合，在参数量和主要矩阵计算预算相当时，用部分门控换取更宽的专家表示。三种随机种子的 MoE 语言模型实验中，75M 和 152M 参数规模的验证损失均改善，30M 结果不一致。它启发稀疏推荐专家重新分配有限参数预算；证据来自较小规模语言建模，尚未验证大模型或 CTR 场景。

original_abstract.text: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly support longer contexts and serve more concurrent requests, increasing both sequence lengths and batch sizes. Both trends increase KV-cache size and memory traffic during inference. KV-cache quantization reduces these costs, with recent approaches using codebook-based vector quantization to achieve extremely low bit widths. However, hardware constraints limit codebook size, and most methods reconstruct the cache in higher-precision floating-point formats for attention, limiting the computational benefits of quantization. To address these limitations, we introduce MiSTiQ, a drop-in replacement for codebook-based vector quantizers that combines trellis-coded storage with microscaling (MX) formats for low-precision computation. We combine trellis quantization with beam search to encode the KV cache over large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. To support MX computation, we derive MX-Hash functions that generate reconstruction values directly in the target MX element format. These functions use the scale-conditioned marginal distribution of block-normalized Gaussian inputs. On Llama3 and Qwen3, MiSTiQ achieves lower WikiText perplexity and higher GSM8K accuracy than the evaluated baselines across several block-scale formats at approximately 1.25 effective bits per element. With NVFP4, it also achieves the highest LongBench average on both models.
original_abstract.source_title: MiSTiQ: MicroScaling Trellis Quantization for Extreme KV Cache Compression

en.text: MiSTiQ combines trellis-coded KV storage with microscaling formats and reconstructs values directly in the target low-precision element format. Beam-search encoding explores large reconstruction spaces without large codebooks. At about 1.25 effective bits per element, tests on Llama3 and Qwen3 improve the reported perplexity and task metrics over evaluated baselines. This offers a cache-compression design for long-sequence and high-concurrency serving; recommendation transfer and end-to-end serving speedups are not established by the abstract.

zh.text: MiSTiQ 将网格编码的键值缓存存储与微缩放低精度格式结合，直接重建目标低精度格式的数值，并用束搜索探索较大的重建空间，避免依赖大型码本。在每元素约 1.25 个有效比特时，Llama3、Qwen3 上的困惑度和所测任务指标优于比较基线。它为长序列、高并发服务提供缓存压缩思路；摘要未建立推荐迁移效果或端到端服务加速结论。

original_abstract.text: Sparse attention models read a few blocks of keys for every query at a fixed budget and can lose much of their long-context retrieval accuracy at that budget. We ask where this loss is made. Using exact attention mass selection at the shipped budget as an oracle, we show that the selector under-ranks the needle rather than running out of budget. We find attention heads that miss the needle by running a calibration probe that teacher-forces the answer and reads two quantities in every head. The first is the needle attention that the selector forfeits, and the second is the share of the answer's log-probability that fixing the head's selection restores, integrated along the path from the shipped selector to full attention. Four checkpoints of the InfLLM-V2 family and NOSA-8B lose multi-key retrieval in the same three blind heads, which attend to the needle while a mean-pooled key summary dilutes its single decisive token. Full attention in those heads or a 4-bit scorer that keeps the shipped budget recovers most of the loss without training. On MiniCPM4.1-8B at 64K, either fix lifts multi-key retrieval accuracy from 54.1 to 97.5%, level with full attention in every head. In production serving engines, full attention in those heads keeps 84 to 89% of the time to first token (TTFT) that sparse attention saves at 32K to 128K context length. Beyond the InfLLM-V2 selector lineage, one unified rule flags attention heads above a threshold swept on each checkpoint until they close most of the gap to full attention on calibration prompts. A similar small set of blind attention heads carry the loss for the SeerAttention-R gates, NSA, and DashAttention, whereas many such heads exist in MoBA. On Qwen3-8B with the SeerAttention-R gates, full attention in 18 of 288 key-value heads lifts multi-key retrieval accuracy from 29.8 to 97.7%.
original_abstract.source_title: Lost in a Few Heads: Diagnosing and Repairing Block Selection in Sparse Attention

en.text: This study localizes sparse-attention retrieval failures to block selectors in a small subset of heads for several model families. Calibration identifies heads whose pooled key summaries hide decisive tokens; full attention in those heads or a 4-bit scorer recovers much of the loss without training. On MiniCPM4.1-8B at 64K, multi-key retrieval rises from 54.1% to 97.5%. It motivates head-specific selection diagnostics for long-history recommendation, although the experiments are on language models and some architectures require many repaired heads.

zh.text: 该研究把若干模型的稀疏注意力检索损失定位到少数注意力头的块选择器：平均池化的键摘要可能掩盖决定性词元。校准后，对这些头恢复完整注意力或改用 4 位评分器，无需训练即可挽回大部分损失。MiniCPM4.1-8B 在 64K 上下文的多键检索准确率从 54.1% 升至 97.5%。这启发长历史推荐按注意力头诊断选择误差；实验对象是语言模型，且部分架构需要修复更多头。

original_abstract.text: Memory-augmented recommenders built on large language models (LLMs) maintain a natural-language profile of each user. These profiles are updated by a user profile update path that revises the profile as new interactions arrive and are consumed by downstream task paths like ranking. Because these user profiles are stored as text in the user memory, every ranking LLM call that consumes them must splice them in the prompt and calculate the KV cache of them during the prefill phase. Given these ranking LLM calls are prefill heavy (long prompt but short decoded output) and repeatedly called, these repeated prefill of user profile text dominates the serving. Prefix caching cannot remove it, because these user profiles are preceded by different text in different calls. We present KVUse, which stores the user profiles as reusable key-value (KV) caches instead of text. KVUse trains lightweight LoRA writers by self-distillation, so that the user profile update call produces the reusable KV of the user profile while decoding it, and the LLM can read these reusable KV at new positions and behind new context without recomputation. KVUse also has a customized KV scheduler that uploads the stored reusable KV of the next batch while the current batch is computed, hiding the KV transfer from host memory behind GPU computation. On four InstructRec datasets with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, KVUse shows no statistically significant difference in ranking quality from full prefill over continuous memory update rounds. Under saturated load, KVUse raises the throughput of the downstream scoring path by 4.0x-4.5x and of the profile update path by 1.4x-1.9x.
original_abstract.source_title: KVUse: Reusable-KV User Memory for Efficient LLM Recommenders

en.text: KVUse stores user profiles as reusable key-value caches and trains lightweight writers by self-distillation so ranking calls can consume them at new positions and behind different context. A scheduler overlaps host-to-GPU cache transfer with computation. On four InstructRec datasets with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, ranking quality shows no statistically significant difference from full prefill, while saturated-load scoring throughput rises 4.0–4.5×. It offers a concrete compute-reuse design for scaling repeated user-conditioned ranking; the reported evidence is specific to those workloads.

zh.text: KVUse 将用户画像保存为可复用的键值缓存，并用自蒸馏训练轻量写入模块，让画像换到不同位置、接在不同上下文之后仍能直接读取；调度器再把缓存传输与 GPU 计算重叠。在四个 InstructRec 数据集和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，排序质量与完整预填充没有统计显著差异，饱和负载下评分吞吐提高 4.0–4.5 倍。对 CTR scaling 的借鉴是复用重复的用户侧计算，收益范围限于论文测试的模型和负载。

original_abstract.text: Most recommenders score each item in the catalog separately, and do not explicitly model which semantic region of the catalog a recommendation belongs to. Models expressive enough to offer that control are often too slow to run over a full catalog for online inference. In this paper, we present Cluster-Guided Generative Reconstruction (CG2R), which learns a hierarchy of semantic clusters and uses a cluster-level prior to steer item ranking for personalized recommendations. Unlike existing systems that only use clusters to pre-select candidates, CG2R adds the cluster prior directly to the item scoring rule, so that the learned cluster structure shapes the ranking itself. Because the prior is assembled from cluster centroids rather than per-item statistics, it remains defined even for cold-start users when no history is available. Across the three benchmark datasets evaluated, CG2R outperforms classical, neural, and LLM-based baselines in terms of Recall and nDCG, with its performance gains widening as the catalog grows sparser. In addition, CG2R serves recommendations in milliseconds, suggesting potential as low-latency first-stage retrieval.
original_abstract.source_title: Cluster-Guided Decoding with Trust-Region Constraints for Personalized Recommendation

en.text: CG2R learns hierarchical semantic clusters and inserts a cluster prior directly into item scoring, rather than using clusters only to select candidates. Centroid-based priors remain defined for users without interaction history. Three benchmarks show improved Recall and nDCG against the evaluated classical, neural and LLM baselines, with millisecond serving. The transferable idea is to incorporate coarse semantic structure into low-latency retrieval scoring; production CTR gains are not established.

zh.text: CG2R 学习分层语义簇，并把簇先验直接加入物品评分，使簇结构参与排序。先验由簇中心构造，没有交互历史的新用户也能使用。论文在三个基准上报告了相对所测传统、神经网络和大模型基线的 Recall、nDCG 改善，以及毫秒级服务。可借鉴之处是让粗粒度语义结构参与低延迟召回评分；尚不能据此推断线上 CTR 收益。

original_abstract.text: Block-wise diffusion language models (DLMs) refine multiple tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. Their long-context inference, however, remains bottlenecked by memory-bound attention: every denoising step repeatedly reads a growing historical key--value (KV) cache. Directly applying sparse attention does not fully solve this problem, because different queries can select different pages, inflating the block's collective read set, while repeated support construction adds overhead and permanent eviction can discard information needed later. We present RISA, a recoverable sparse-attention method with shared read plans for block-wise DLMs. RISA exploits the fact that historical KV remains fixed within a block while queries evolve across denoising steps. Newly generated history is organized into exact priority and recovery tiers; seed queries then build a protected, bounded read plan whose indices are reused across the block while attention is recomputed with fresh queries and current-block KV. This separates history preservation from repeated reading and amortizes sparse-support construction without changing the backbone or decoder. On DreamReasoner-8B, RISA retains comparable task performance. At 32K, the default configuration speeds up attention by $2.67\times$ and fixed-trajectory requests by $1.36\times$ over dense, and attention speedup reaches $5.53\times$ at 128K. Across eight settings on three models, RISA decodes faster than the tested MAGE, QUEST, and LoSA budgets at matched KL.
original_abstract.source_title: RISA: Recoverable Sparse Attention for Block-Diffusion Language Models

en.text: RISA separates preservation of historical KV states from repeated reads in block-diffusion language models. Priority and recovery tiers retain history, while a bounded shared read plan is reused across denoising steps with fresh queries. On DreamReasoner-8B at 32K, the default configuration accelerates attention 2.67× and fixed-trajectory requests 1.36× over dense attention with comparable task performance. Reusing sparse read plans is relevant to iterative recommendation inference, but this transfer is not evaluated in the paper.

zh.text: RISA 将块扩散语言模型中的历史键值保存与反复读取分开：优先层和恢复层保留历史，同一块的去噪步骤复用有界读取计划，同时重新计算当前查询的注意力。DreamReasoner-8B 在 32K 上下文中，默认配置相对稠密注意力取得 2.67 倍注意力加速、1.36 倍固定轨迹请求加速，任务表现相近。复用稀疏读取计划可启发迭代式推荐推理，但论文没有验证这一迁移。

original_abstract.text: Listwise LLM rerankers cannot reliably rank hundreds of documents in a single call, and rely on schedules to orchestrate their calls. Parallel schedules split candidates into groups and advance a fixed quota from each. When a group holds more of the top passages than its quota, some are cut, and expensive repair calls become required. We show that the way candidates are split matters where such a quota can bind, and that, in expected cuts, the best split there deals them round-robin by retriever rank, like cards. Although not conceptually new, dealing has remained unanalyzed. We prove that, under a simple retriever model, no split with equal quotas cuts fewer of the true top ten on average, and that contiguous chunks cut more as the retriever improves. DealRank, the simplest schedule our analysis allows, is on average within 0.1 nDCG@10 points of the best schedules over six LLMs, in two rounds. It is consistently 1.1 to 1.4 times faster than BlitzRank with concurrent first calls up to a thousand candidates. There, it needs three rounds and is eleven times faster than the sliding window. In existing schedules such as BlitzRank, dealing reduces repair calls from 59% of queries to 14%, improving latency with no significant change in quality. Random partitioning appears equivalent at a quota of four, as predicted, but ties results to the seed and trails by 1.3 nDCG@10 points at a quota of one over a dense retriever.
original_abstract.source_title: Deal With It: On Better Schedules for Listwise Reranking

en.text: DealRank distributes retriever-ranked candidates round-robin across parallel listwise reranking calls, reducing good candidates lost to per-group quotas. Under a simple retriever model, this minimizes expected top-ten cuts among equal-quota splits. Across six LLMs it is within 0.1 nDCG@10 points of the best schedules on average and is 1.1–1.4× faster than BlitzRank. This offers a scheduling technique for scaling candidate reranking without changing the underlying ranker; the optimality claim depends on the stated model.

zh.text: DealRank 按初始检索排名轮流向各个并行重排组分配候选，减少好候选集中在同一组、被组内晋级名额截掉的情况。在论文的简化检索模型下，这种分组使等配额方案的前十名候选预期损失最小。六种大模型实验中，其平均 nDCG@10 距最佳调度不超过 0.1 个点，比 BlitzRank 快 1.1–1.4 倍。它为扩大重排候选量提供了调度层面的办法，最优性结论受模型假设限制。

original_abstract.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for generative recommendation, where recommended items are generated directly from users' interaction histories. To further improve recommendation quality, reinforcement learning (RL) has been applied to align these models with recommendation objectives. However, existing RL methods rely on scalar rewards to implicitly guide exploration. These rewards do not specify which aspects of a candidate conflict with the user's preferences or how the next candidate should differ. To address this gap, we propose VerRec, a verbalized feedback-guided RL framework for generative recommendation. Specifically, a user simulator generates personalized verbalized feedback based on the user's historical preferences and the candidate item profile. The policy uses this feedback to produce refined recommendations. Original and refined candidates form an expanded group and are jointly optimized with group relative policy optimization. The user simulator is only required during training and is removed at inference time. Experiments on three Amazon review datasets with two generative recommendation backbones demonstrate that VerRec improves recommendation accuracy and ranking quality. Further analyses show that verbalized guidance encourages exploration of more diverse candidates and helps the policy discover more rewarding recommendations during training.
original_abstract.source_title: More Than a Score: Reinforcement Learning with Verbalized Feedback for Generative Recommendation

en.text: VerRec augments scalar-reward RL with personalized verbal feedback from a user simulator. Original and feedback-refined candidates are optimized together with group-relative policy optimization; the simulator is used only during training. Experiments with two generative recommendation backbones on three Amazon review datasets report improved accuracy and ranking quality. It suggests enriching training-time exploration without adding the simulator to the serving path, but does not establish industrial latency or CTR gains.

zh.text: VerRec 在标量奖励之外加入用户模拟器生成的文字反馈，指出候选与历史偏好的不一致，再让策略生成改进候选。原候选和改进候选共同参与组相对策略优化，模拟器只在训练时使用。两个生成式推荐骨干、三个 Amazon 评论数据集的实验报告了准确率和排序质量改善。可借鉴的是增加训练探索信息而不把模拟器带入服务链路，论文未据此证明工业延迟或 CTR 收益。

original_abstract.text: Generative recommenders decode the semantic ID of a user's next item with a language model, and post-training them with reinforcement learning (RL) after supervised fine-tuning (SFT) has become standard practice. The gains are mostly reported on the first ten results, yet in deployment such models hand hundreds of candidates to a downstream ranker or reward model. We show that RL post-training has a hidden cost: it improves accuracy at the top of the list (hit@K for small K) but, on all five datasets we study, lowers the recall of the candidate list (hit@K for K in the hundreds). The model becomes a better ranker and a worse retriever. Controlled experiments trace the loss to the negative advantages that RL assigns to the candidates it samples, the rollout. The root cause is that only one next item is logged per user, so RL treats every other candidate as wrong. Yet these candidates are the model's most plausible alternatives, and often the next items of other users with similar histories. Penalising them pushes down exactly what similar users choose next, and these items drop out of those users' candidate lists. This diagnosis points directly to a remedy: out-of-rollout anchoring, a single additional loss term that preserves the SFT model's ordering of the items outside the rollout. It keeps the gain at the top and restores recall to the SFT level on all five datasets, and it is effective under other RL configurations as well. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of this recall loss: we measure it, identify its cause, and show that, once the cause is known, a simple remedy suffices.
original_abstract.source_title: Better Rankers, Worse Retrievers: The Hidden Cost of RL Post-Training in Generative Recommendation

en.text: Across five datasets, RL post-training improves small-K hit rates but reduces recall when generative recommenders supply hundreds of candidates. Controlled experiments attribute this to negative-advantage penalties on plausible sampled alternatives under single-next-item supervision. Out-of-rollout anchoring preserves the supervised model’s ordering outside sampled candidates and restores recall while retaining top-list gains. For scalable recommendation pipelines, the lesson is to evaluate candidate coverage alongside top-rank accuracy; evidence is from the studied datasets and RL settings.

zh.text: 论文在五个数据集上发现，强化学习后训练虽能改善靠前结果的命中率，却会降低数百候选范围的召回。控制实验将问题追溯到单个后续物品监督下，对其他合理采样候选施加的负优势惩罚。新增约束保留监督模型在采样集合之外的物品顺序，在所测设置中恢复召回并保留头部收益。对大规模推荐链路的启示是同时检查候选覆盖与前列准确率，不能只用前十名指标衡量召回模型。
